context: M9 o7. 8th Ave & W 35th St. Delphine, tailing, sees two men step out of a doorway at Teddy.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule five: know where your money's going. Mine's going to Thirty-First and Eighth.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Two of Lonnie's boys. In the doorway. That's not police. That's a stickup.

lines.speaker: char.lonnie_gage
lines.text: Make it look bad, fellas. Jimmy says the new man's soft.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Penn Station. Eighth Avenue doors. Go!
